title: About
body:
About Mark-a-Spot

Mark-a-Spot is an open source platform that connects citizens with local government. Report issues in public spaces, track their progress, and help improve your community.

How It Works

Spotted something that needs attention? Submit a report by taking a photo – our AI will recognize the issue and suggest the right category. Or describe the problem yourself and pin it on the map. Your report goes directly to the responsible department, and you can follow the status until it's resolved.

Open Data & Open311

Transparency matters. All reports (without personal data) are publicly accessible – both on this platform and via the Open311 API. This open standard allows third-party apps and services to connect with the system.

Open Source

Mark-a-Spot is free and open source, built on Drupal. Learn more at mark-a-spot.com.

Privacy Policy

We take your privacy seriously. When you submit a report, we collect:

  • Report details (location, description, category, photos)
  • Contact information (if provided)

This information is used to:

  • Process and respond to your report
  • Improve city services
  • Generate anonymized statistics

Personal information is not publicly displayed. Report details (excluding personal information) are available as open data.

Terms of Use

By using this platform, you agree to:

  • Provide accurate information
  • Not submit false or misleading reports
  • Not use the platform for emergency situations
  • Grant us permission to share report details (excluding personal information) as open data

Technical Implementation

This platform is built on Mark-a-Spot, an open source civic issue tracking solution based on Drupal. For more information, visit markaspot.de.
